title: What France's far right has learned from Israel's apartheid system
content: There are regular warnings that France risks succumbing to fascism. But Mussolini's Italy may not be the model that attracts the far right; it could be Binyamin Netanyahu's de facto apartheid state.

title: Can capitalism save Cuba's revolution?
content: Cuba is undergoing its biggest economic transformation in decades: private firms are back and small businesses employ a quarter of the workforce. But market reform has brought no political opening.

title: Donald Trump's Latin American proconsuls
content: The US once supported military coups to keep Latin America under its control. Now, a weaker left and the rise of organised crime are helping the far right assert itself. This suits the White House just fine.

title: When the world took Ethiopia's side
content: Mussolini's attack on Ethiopia in 1935 caused more than half a million deaths by the end of the Italian occupation in 1941. Why were the sanctions imposed on Italy only half-heartedly enforced?

title: White Australia's ‘unprecedented act of racism'?
content: Australians rejected the idea of creating the Indigenous Voice to Parliament advisory body in October 2023. Two years after this stinging defeat, the state of Victoria signed a treaty with its First Peoples.

title: The geopolitics of luxury hotels
content: While Saudi Arabia is banking on industrial investment and the UAE on logistics infrastructure, Qatar has gone for luxury tourism to consolidate its international position and diversify its economy.

title: South Korea: on the threshold of two worlds
content: South Korea's rapid modernisation has brought a need for reassurance often found through shamans and their connection with the spirit world. The practitioners are reaping its economic rewards.

title: Hirschfeld and Wolf: pioneers of sexual freedom
content: Before the Nazis came to power, Berlin was the centre of bold campaigns against state control over the body, championing abortion rights, homosexual equality and new understandings of sex and gender.

title: Inside meth's ‘golden triangle'
